verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy documents its own Test mode for building and testing a full API integration, which is a sandbox-style environment rather than a dry-run. The evidence is a single mention, though, and does not describe isolation from live data, test credentials, or how test-mode behavior differs from production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that test-mode data is separate from production, details on test API keys and test payments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can build and test a full API integration with Lemon Squeezy using [Test mode](/help/getting-started/test-mode).
